text_en: If I speak in the tongues of mortals and of angels, but do not have love, I am a noisy gong or a clanging cymbal.
text_cn: 我若能说人间的语言，和能说天使的语言；但我若没有爱，我就成了个发声的锣，或发响的钹。

text_en: And if I have prophetic powers, and understand all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have all faith, so as to remove mountains, but do not have love, I am nothing.
text_cn: 我若有先知之恩，又明白一切奥秘和各种知识；我若有全备的信心，甚至能移山；但我若没有爱，我什么也不算。

text_en: If I give away all my possessions, and if I hand over my body so that I may boast, but do not have love, I gain nothing.
text_cn: 我若把我所有的财产全施舍了，我若舍身投火被焚；但我若没有爱，为我毫无益处。

text_en: Love is patient; love is kind; love is not envious or boastful or arrogant
text_cn: 爱是含忍的，爱是慈祥的，爱不嫉妒，不夸张，不自大，

text_en: or rude. It does not insist on its own way; it is not irritable or resentful;
text_cn: 不作无礼的事，不求己益，不动怒，不图谋恶事，

text_en: it does not rejoice in wrongdoing, but rejoices in the truth.
text_cn: 不以不义为乐，却与真理同乐：

text_en: It bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things.
text_cn: 凡事包容，凡事相信，凡事盼望，凡事忍耐。

text_en: Love never ends. But as for prophecies, they will come to an end; as for tongues, they will cease; as for knowledge, it will come to an end.
text_cn: 爱永存不朽，而先知之恩，终必消失；语言之恩，终必停止；知识之恩，终必消逝。

text_en: For we know only in part, and we prophesy only in part;
text_cn: 因为我们现在所知道的，只是局部的；我们作先知所讲的，也只是局部的；

text_en: but when the complete comes, the partial will come to an end.
text_cn: 及至那圆满的一来到，局部的就必要消逝。

text_en: When I was a child, I spoke like a child, I thought like a child, I reasoned like a child; when I became an adult, I put an end to childish ways.
text_cn: 当我是孩子的时候，说话像孩子，看事像孩子，思想像孩子；几时我一成了人，就把孩子的事丢弃了。

text_en: For now we see in a mirror, dimly, but then we will see face to face. Now I know only in part; then I will know fully, even as I have been fully known.
text_cn: 我们现在是藉着镜子观看，模糊不清，到那时，就要面对面的观看了。我现在所认识的，只是局部的，那时我就要全认清了，如同我全被认清一样。

text_en: And now faith, hope, and love abide, these three; and the greatest of these is love.
text_cn: 现今存在的，有信、望、爱这三样，但其中最大的是爱。
